data.name: Setup.Intro
data.value: Create the Owner account. The one-time code is shown on the server console.

data.name: Setup.Login.Length
data.value: The login must be 4 to 64 characters long.

data.name: Setup.Login.Characters
data.value: The login may contain only Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.

data.name: Setup.Password.Length
data.value: The password must be 15 to 128 characters long.

data.name: Setup.Password.ContainsLogin
data.value: The password may not equal or contain the login.

data.name: Setup.SetupCode.Invalid
data.value: The one-time code is not correct.

data.name: Setup.AlreadyCreated
data.value: The Owner account has already been created. Sign in.

data.name: SignIn.Refused
data.value: Wrong login or password, or sign-in is temporarily locked after several failed attempts — try again later.

data.name: Home.SignedIn
data.value: You are signed in as the Owner.

data.name: Error.PageExpired
data.value: The page has expired — reload it and try again.

data.name: Installation.Identifier.ConfigurationNote
data.value: When deploying, put this identifier into the school installation's configuration. An installation without it does not start.

data.name: Installation.BackToList
data.value: Back to the list of schools

data.name: Installation.ClientId.ChangeNote
data.value: Change the client ID only when the school's service account was created again. After the change, the school's super admin must authorize domain-wide delegation for the new client ID again. The installation picks up the new value no later than its next legitimacy check, within 6 hours.

data.name: Installation.Name.Length
data.value: The school name must be at most 200 characters.

data.name: Installation.Name.EdgeWhitespace
data.value: The school name must not start or end with a space.

data.name: Installation.Name.InvalidCharacters
data.value: The school name contains characters that are not allowed (line breaks, tabs or invisible characters).

data.name: Installation.Domain.Length
data.value: The domain must be 3 to 253 characters long.

data.name: Installation.Domain.Characters
data.value: The domain may contain only Latin letters, digits, dots and hyphens — no https://, path or @.

data.name: Installation.Domain.NoDot
data.value: The domain must contain at least one dot.

data.name: Installation.Domain.Labels
data.value: Each part of the domain between dots must be non-empty, at most 63 characters, and must not start or end with a hyphen.

data.name: Installation.Domain.Idn
data.value: Internationalized domains (a part starting with xn--) are not supported.

data.name: Installation.Domain.Taken
data.value: This domain is already registered to another installation. A school returning to its former domain is resumed, not registered again.

data.name: Installation.ClientId.Format
data.value: The client ID must consist of digits only — 10 to 32 of them.

data.name: Installation.ClientId.Taken
data.value: This client ID is already registered to another installation.
